key_terms: An Airflow object that names a logical data product by URI. Its update event is orchestration metadata, not a copy of the data.
A record that a producer task updated an asset, which can trigger a consumer DAG scheduled on that asset.
Creating task instances at runtime from a collection, unlike a Python loop that runs when the DAG file is parsed.
A named limit on how many task instances can run at once. The workshop uses a one-slot pool to make its concurrency policy explicit.
A consumer reading the actual retained files and recording their source identities, rather than trusting the asset event alone.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
